Cooler spell (at most small polar ice)
Temperature: Scotese et al. (2021), Earth-Science Reviews 215: 103503, one value per million years.
Period dates: International Commission on Stratigraphy chart (2024). Ice-age dates rounded.
Brief cold spikes: end-Ordovician glaciation about 445 million years ago; dinosaur-killing impact 66 million years ago.
